**q22.** Dispatcher: `APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15` (called from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`), which funnels into `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:47`). Delivery package: `internal/webhook` (`webhook.PostAsync` → queue → `webhook.Post`, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120,184`). Signing: Standard Webhooks-style HMAC-SHA256 over `msgID.timestamp.body` with the per-webhook signing secret (`whsec_`-prefixed base64 key), sent as `webhook-id` / `webhook-timestamp` / `webhook-signature: v1,<base64>` headers (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:132-151`).

**q23.**
- SQL schema: `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:33` (also `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql`)
- Go store model: `store/memo.go:34`
- API proto message: `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:198`
- Generated Go: `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.go`
- Generated frontend types: `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`

**q24.**
- `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:178` (`useCreateMemo`) — the editor's actual submit path goes through `web/src/components/MemoEditor/services/memoService.ts:120`
- `web/src/connect.ts:197` (`memoServiceClient.createMemo`)
- `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:21` (`MemoService.CreateMemo`)
- `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` (handler; Connect entry at `connect_services.go:306`)
- `store/memo.go:109` (`Store.CreateMemo`)
- `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (INSERT; also `store/db/postgres/memo.go:16`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:16`)

**q25.** Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) wrapped by the in-repo `filter` package — `internal/filter/engine.go:13-33` (schema in `schema.go`, parser/IR in `parser.go`/`ir.go`). Mechanism: the handler validates the filter (`server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go:336` / `memo_service.go:212`) and stores it in `FindMemo.Filters`; each dialect driver calls `filter.DefaultEngine()` + `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.Dialect<X>, &where, &args)` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:54-58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:65-69`), which compiles the CEL expression into a dialect-agnostic condition tree and renders it to parameterized SQL per dialect in `internal/filter/render.go`.

**q26.** `memo_relation` (both directions), `attachment`, `memo` (comment memo rows deleted first, then the memo row itself), and `memo_share` (removed by the DB-level `ON DELETE CASCADE` FK, `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:102-110`). `reaction` rows are only read for the webhook payload, not deleted (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:545-550`).

**q27.** Mechanism: the built `web/dist` output is compiled into the binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware plus an SPA `index.html` fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21, 40-59` (`FrontendService.Serve`), invoked from `server/server.go:71`.

**q28.**
- `s3presign.Runner` — `RunOnce` at startup, then a `time.Ticker` every 12h (`server/server.go:158-167`; `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41`)
- webhook async dispatch pool — 4 goroutines draining a 128-slot channel, started by package `init()` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54` (not started by `Server.Start`)
- Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` (full job scheduler with middleware) is referenced only by its own tests — nothing in `server/` imports it; and `server/runner/memopayload.Runner`/`NewRunner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:19-27`) is never instantiated — only the standalone `RebuildMemoPayload` function is used (`memo_service.go:108,447`).

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:155-176` (attached to the transport at `:184-190`). Tokens: a short-lived JWT access token held in memory/localStorage with cross-tab `BroadcastChannel` sync (`web/src/auth-state.ts`), refreshed via a `credentials: "include"` HTTP-only refresh-token cookie (`memos_refresh`) using `AuthService.RefreshToken` (`connect.ts:65-89`); Personal Access Tokens are also accepted server-side. Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`authenticator.go` `Authenticate`/`AuthenticateByAccessTokenV2`/`AuthenticateByRefreshToken`/`AuthenticateByPAT`, `token.go`), used by `NewAuthorizer`/`NewAuthInterceptor` in `server/router/api/v1/authz.go` and `connect_interceptors.go`.

**q30.**
- memo created: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15` (called at `memo_service.go:157`)
- memo updated: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` — `memo_service_webhooks.go:20` (called at `memo_update_helpers.go:67`)
- memo deleted: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` — `memo_service_webhooks.go:25` (called at `memo_service.go:562`)
- comment created: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` — `memo_service_webhooks.go:30` (called at `memo_service_comments.go:119`)

The first three converge on `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` / `:120`.
